newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation slows to 0.3 pct in Dec 16 week.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation slows to 0.3 pct in Dec 16 week.

text.p: Russian inflation slowed in the week ended December 16 to 0.3 percent from 0.4 percent in the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Thursday.
Inflation in the first 16 days of December was 0.6 percent, compared with 1.9 percent in the whole of November.
The committee said that if current trends were maintained, inflation for December would be 1.1 percent and 22 percent for the year. Prices were 131 percent higher year-on-year in December 1995.
